name: enterprise-customer-management
description: Enterprise-oriented Angular learning repository - Customer Management

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @ecm/web
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:lint && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:lint && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: eslint . && npm run lint:styles && npm run lint:architecture && npm run lint:secrets && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run perf:budgets && npm run e2e && npm run e2e:production
scripts.e2e:production: npm run build:contracts && playwright test --config playwright.production.config.ts
